title: AUTOSAR DLT: Remove a vestigial loop.
description:
Remove a "while" loop which can never iterate or serve any other purpose (no
"continue"/"break", loop body ends with "return").

Remove the unreachable code below the loop.

With the loop gone, and with no loops in callers, we can now depend on
wtap_reset_rec to have cleared the buffer for us before this code is reached,
so we can stop resetting the buffer ourselves.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: @LarsVoelker That loop always finishes after one trip through the loop; was it done that way because some other file format readers have to scan through records or blocks when trying to find a record to provide to Wireshark?

Honestly, I am not sure - the code is like 4 years old after all. I probably used another dissector to start with and did miss that!?

Anyhow, I just compiled the code and opened a few files. Looked good.
